findings.issue: Client-side filter navigation uses history.pushState but no popstate handler, so pressing back/forward after filtering changes the URL while the DOM keeps showing the old results; each debounced keystroke also pushes a new history entry.
findings.suggestion: Add a popstate listener that re-renders for the new URL (or re-fetch on popstate), and prefer replaceState for search-as-you-type so history isn't polluted.

findings.issue: strict is disabled and API payloads flow through the app as `any` (app/src/lib/pokeapi.ts, app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:20-27), forfeiting the type safety Astro's TS-first toolchain provides.
findings.suggestion: Enable strict (the astro/tsconfigs base defaults to it) and add interfaces for the PokeAPI resources in lib/, typing page-level locals instead of `let species: any`.

findings.issue: API_BASE_URL is read via process.env at module load; current Astro docs recommend import.meta.env / the astro:env schema for type-safe, validated environment variables (process.env is only the documented fallback for config files and scripts).
findings.suggestion: Define API_BASE_URL in astro.config.mjs via env.schema with envField.string({ context: 'server' }) and import it from astro:env/server.

findings.issue: The NotFoundError try/catch + Astro.response.status = 404 + <NotFound /> block is copy-pasted into all four dynamic routes (moves/[name].astro:11, abilities/[name].astro:11, types/[name].astro:9).
findings.suggestion: Extract a helper such as `fetchOrNotFound(path)` returning a discriminated result, or render the not-found shell from a middleware-level catch.

findings.issue: TypeBadge supports an href variant that is never used, while three pages (pokemon/[name].astro:337, moves/[name].astro:72, types/[name].astro:79) hand-write the identical `<a class="type-badge" data-type=…>` markup.
findings.suggestion: Either use TypeBadge everywhere (passing href), or drop the unused href branch and keep the hand-rolled markup consistent.

findings.issue: Dead code: getSpeciesById is never called, and .section-card (app/src/styles/global.css:144) has no matching markup.

The filter swap replaces #results innerHTML wholesale with no focus management, no aria-live announcement of the new result count, and in-flight fetches are never aborted (only discarded via requestId).
findings.suggestion: Wrap the result count in an aria-live region, and abort superseded requests with an AbortController.

findings.issue: Table sorting treats missing values as empty strings for text columns (Type, Category, Move), so they would sort first ascending rather than last in both directions as the spec requires; the numeric columns handle this correctly.
findings.suggestion: Apply the same missing-value check used for numericKeys to the string columns.

findings.issue: With zero matches the page still renders "Page 1 of 1" inside the pagination nav below the empty-state message.
findings.suggestion: Hide the pagination nav when filtered.length === 0.

findings.issue: The page component carries ~190 lines of data shaping (version-group resolution, move enrichment, method ordering) inline, duplicating domain logic that a future move/ability page change would have to touch separately; the codebase also contains a single comment in total.
findings.suggestion: Move move-table assembly into lib/ and add brief comments documenting the caching and ordering assumptions.

summary: A genuinely idiomatic Astro 7 SSR app: native dynamic routing, correct 404s, a tidy two-module data layer with well-managed in-memory caching, and clean token-driven CSS. The main things I'd block on are the home page's popstate-less pushState navigation (back button shows stale results) and the disabled strict mode with pervasive `any`. Everything else is a small, mechanical round of deduplication and dead-code cleanup before approving.
